It's going to take some time to adjust. I also know that Tim has a short fuse, so I don't want to upset him by not calling him Thor. But at the same time, I don't want to feel like I'm being hypocritical or insincere if I'm not fully comfortable with the change. I need to find a balance between respecting his wishes and maintaining our friendship. Maybe I should talk to him about this directly. I don't want to lose a long-term friend over something like this, but I also don't want to compromise my own comfort and authenticity. I wonder if there's a middle ground. Maybe I can start by using both names interchangeably until I get more comfortable. Or perhaps I can use Thor in specific contexts and Tim in others.
